statements.query: MATCH (distribution:AWSCloudfrontDistribution)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE distribution.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL WITH distribution LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE distribution.exposed_internet, distribution.exposed_internet_type, distribution.publicContext return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: A CloudFront distribution is an internet-facing edge endpoint by design; it serves the internet whenever it is enabled.
statements.query: MATCH (distribution:AWSCloudfrontDistribution{enabled: true})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) SET distribution.exposed_internet = true ,(CASE WHEN NOT 'enabled_distribution' IN coalesce(distribution.exposed_internet_type , []) THEN distribution END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(distribution.exposed_internet_type , []) + 'enabled_distribution';

MATCH (distribution:AWSCloudfrontDistribution)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE distribution.exposed_internet = true WITH distribution SET distribution.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: distribution.id, resourceType: 'aws-cloudfront-distribution', context: [{distributionId: distribution.id, domainName: distribution.domain_name, status: distribution.status, viewerProtocolPolicy: distribution.viewer_protocol_policy, exposureTypes: distribution.exposed_internet_type, aliases: coalesce(distribution.aliases, []), enabled: coalesce(distribution.enabled, false)}]}])
